scenarios: the browser view's process is killed between two observations; the host logs the loss, restarts the view at its page and attaches it again to the same session; the Core reports the session open with the host attached; the agent's next observation is a delta showing the same page unchanged; the task completes on the same Core process
proof: the browser view is a worker on the canonical contracts; its crash corrupts nothing in the Core and its restart reattaches the same session.
audit: PARTIAL before: the view was a dedicated worker on the contracts and a Core restart re-attached it; the view's own process dying left a dead view.
limitations: a request in flight at the crash fails once; the restarted page is a fresh load; the cloud browser's loss is the sandbox-loss path.
